LESSON: INTERDEPENDENCE OF PEOPLE

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: SOCIAL STUDIES
Strand: People and Population
Topic 2.1: Interdependence of people
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 6

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Interdependence of people, part of People and Population in Grade 4 SOCIAL STUDIES.

Key inquiry question: How do people in the county depend on each other? 2. Why should we support each other in the county?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

A. identify ways in which people depend on each other in the county,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Interdependence of people in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

B. explain the benefits of interdependence of people in the county,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Interdependence of people in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

C. use chart to illustrate the benefits of interdependence people,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Interdependence of people in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

D. appreciate the interdependence of people in the County.

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Interdependence of people in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Citizenship: Learners explain the benefits of interdependence of people in the county.

● Creativity and imagination: Learners role-play the interdependence of people in the county.

Values:
Social justice: Learners discuss benefits of interdependence among people in the county

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

● Social cohesion: Learners identify ways in which people depend on each other in the county.

● Social cohesion: Learners respect others’ views/feelings as they work to create a chart on benefits of interdependence

among people.
